evidence: Authored standard-DH numerical solver cases and CLI execution; no native solver or controller claims

contract.configuration: Optional positive finite numeric ik_step_limit on each explicit DH row, in degrees for revolute joints and millimetres for prismatic joints
contract.defaults: 10 degrees for revolute joints, 100 millimetres for prismatic joints; explicit prismatic 10 retains the earlier cap
contract.update: One common scale limits every free-axis proposed increment; line search can reduce it further, preserving proposal direction before joint-limit clamps
contract.fixed_axes: Fixed external joints and zero-travel rows are excluded from step scaling
contract.consumers: Shared POS2JOINT, source/interface/ARRAY/record and variable-transfer inverse solving, IN_RANGE and CHECK_EPOS
contract.persistence: Explicit row settings survive ordinary context JSON, including grouped models; executable continuations are not restored

boundaries: Numerical search settings do not specify motion, speed, acceleration or native/controller behavior
Changing a cap can change convergence and the first solution found; failed solving does not prove unreachability
Existing limits, per-seed iterations, source evaluation budgets, fixed external axes and destination-preserving failures remain
No inferred robot model, calibration, native CONFIG branch, collision or physical acceptance; strict mode deferred
